claim.quote: A new measurement of the parity violating asymmetry in elastic electron scattering on hydrogen at backward angles and at a four momentum transfer of Q^2=0.22 (GeV/c)^2 is reported here.

name: A4: backward-angle asymmetry and separated strange form factors at Q^2 = 0.22 (GeV/c)^2

summary.plain: With the A4 detector turned around to catch backward-scattered electrons, the team measured a second asymmetry at the same momentum transfer as its forward measurement. The two together separate, for the first time at this point, the strange quarks' electric and magnetic contributions to the proton.
summary.technical: A_LR = (-17.23 +- 0.82 stat +- 0.89 syst) ppm at backward angles (beam energy 315.1 MeV), Standard Model expectation without strangeness A_0 = (-15.87 +- 1.22) ppm; combined with the forward-angle data, G_E^s(0.22) = 0.050 +- 0.038 +- 0.019 and G_M^s(0.22) = -0.14 +- 0.11 +- 0.11.

title: Measurement of Strange Quark Contributions to the Vector Form Factors of the Proton at Q^2=0.22 (GeV/c)^2
why_it_matters: Separates the strange electric and magnetic form factors at Q^2 = 0.22 (GeV/c)^2 within a single experiment.
